variants.name: required_hook_disabled
variants.execution: five one-shot native Codex runs of the exact SDK wrapper with sendActivityStartEvent=false

variants.name: raw_http_bypass
variants.execution: a real loopback request sent the exact marker directly to the safe sink after receiver authentication but without the SDK wrapper
variants.observation: one accepted sink receipt, eventCount=0, readiness=inconclusive

variants.name: model_refusal
variants.execution: a controlled local refusal fixture returned no tool call; the exact live Ollama relay was not widened to an alternate prompt
variants.observation: no SDK attempt and no sink effect; controlled behavior mapping only

variants.name: sink_timeout
variants.execution: a real bounded loopback effect target exceeded the client deadline after exact receiver auth/evaluate evidence
variants.observation: readiness=ready with eventCount=1 but no accepted sink receipt

variants.name: sandbox_denial
variants.execution: five one-shot native Codex runs emitted the exact SDK event, attempted a write beneath the denied root, observed the write error, and proved the path absent
variants.observation: eventCount=1, verified native denial, no sink service or receipt

variants.name: receiver_loss
variants.execution: a real receiver was closed before the authenticated request and the bounded no-proxy client observed connection failure

limits: The controlled refusal is fixture behavior only. A real Granite refusal is not_runnable under the fixed live relay because changing the prompt or accepted request would widen its authority; the five exact live runs all selected recording-tool.
sandbox_prevented_candidate names the Phase 05 evidence shape only. Phase 06 owns final correlation and judgment, so this task emits no judgment object.
The timeout target and refusal fixture are local bounded adversarial components, not provider observations. They prove non-promotion behavior, not external model or network behavior.
No variant can produce blocked: the baseline receiver is ALLOW-only and no isolated real OpenBox decision path ran.
